q: The Yao minimax principle for randomised algorithms states that the expected cost of the best deterministic algorithm on the worst-case input distribution equals:
opts: A lower bound on the randomised complexity: max_D min_A E_D[cost(A)] ≤ min_A max_x cost(A,x)
The entropy of the input distribution
exp: Yao's principle: max over input distributions D of (expected cost of best deterministic algorithm under D) ≤ expected cost of best randomised algorithm on worst-case input. To prove R(f) ≥ C, find D such that every deterministic algorithm has expected cost ≥ C under D.
